title: Rhyolite Ridge Water Pollution Control Permit NEV2020107
summary: NDEP's renewed water-pollution-control permit authorizes regulated construction, operation, and closure subject to pre-operation notification, inspection, monitoring, modeling, and closure conditions.
key_findings: The permit is identified as NEV2020107 for Rhyolite Ridge.
It requires pre-operation notice and inspection and includes later groundwater-model and monitoring-well work.
Authorization subject to conditions does not establish condition satisfaction or operating status.
why_it_matters: It turns a broad authorization into a named pre-operation and compliance checklist.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-specific water and inspection rail.
Creates dated follow-up targets for modeling and monitoring wells.
Separates authorized construction from operation and compliant output.
evidence_limits: The permit does not prove pre-operation inspection or commissioning.
It does not establish current pumping, compliance, production, or water outcomes.
